## 更新 · What's new

- Mac：截图时的工具选项、标注工具、截图操作和快捷键提示合成一块可拖动的「统一控制岛」，全屏截图时也能把整组控制拖离要标注的区域；靠近底部或顶部居中会自动吸附。
  Mac: screenshot tool options, annotation tools, capture actions and shortcut hints now form one draggable control island, so you can move the whole group off the area you are annotating — even in full-screen captures. It snaps to the bottom or top centre.
- Mac：控制岛可固定位置（之后的截图沿用，直到解除），也可用 ⌥⌘T 收起为「把手 + 当前工具 + 展开」小胶囊；移动控制岛不会改变选区和已画的标注。
  Mac: pin the island to keep its position for later captures, or collapse it to a small pill (grip, current tool, expand) with Option-Command-T. Moving it never changes the selection or your annotations.
